Container.Name: firefly-money
Container.Overview: Money is a fast, mobile-friendly web app for Firefly III, the self-hosted personal finance manager. It runs beside your existing Firefly III server and uses its API: an overview dashboard with insights and a safe-to-spend forecast, a transaction feed with quick add in plain words, budgets, bills, rules and more. Your Firefly access token stays in this container and is never sent to the browser. Needs a running Firefly III (6.x) and a Personal Access Token from Firefly (Profile, then Remote access and tokens). Try the demo at https://muffy0906.github.io/firefly-money/
Container.Requires: A running Firefly III server and a Firefly III Personal Access Token.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the Money web app.

Config.Name: Firefly III URL
Config.Description: How this container reaches Firefly III, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8080. No trailing slash. A LAN address also makes the 'Open Firefly III' link work.

Config.Name: Firefly III access token
Config.Description: A Firefly III Personal Access Token (Profile, then Remote access and tokens). It stays in this container.

Config.Name: Dashboard password
Config.Description: The password for the Money sign-in screen. Use something long. Changing it signs every device out.
